database_summary: Soccer (football) relational dataset containing entities for players, teams, leagues, countries and match-level facts plus time-varying attribute snapshots for players and teams. Matches are event/fixture-level rows (one per match). Player_Attributes and Team_Attributes are timestamped snapshots (history/measurements). Player, Team, League, Country are descriptive entity tables. Schema uses player_api_id and player_fifa_api_id keys for linking player snapshots and match lineups; team_api_id/team_fifa_api_id similarly for teams. Many match columns encode lineup positions (home_player_1..11, away_player_1..11 and X/Y coordinates) and aggregated event strings (goal, card, possession). Betting odds are stored as numeric columns on Match. Joins between matches and player attribute snapshots require care because Player_Attributes are many-per-player over time (history) and joining without a date filter will multiply match rows or attach incorrect snapshots.

accepted.name: player_latest_attributes
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  player_fifa_api_id,
  player_api_id,
  date,
  overall_rating,
  potential,
  preferred_foot,
  attacking_work_rate,
  defensive_work_rate,
  crossing,
  finishing,
  heading_accuracy,
  short_passing,
  volleys,
  dribbling,
  curve,
  free_kick_accuracy,
  long_passing,
  ball_control,
  acceleration,
  sprint_speed,
  agility,
  reactions,
  balance,
  shot_power,
  jumping,
  stamina,
  strength,
  long_shots,
  aggression,
  interceptions,
  positioning,
  vision,
  penalties,
  marking,
  standing_tackle,
  sliding_tackle,
  gk_diving,
  gk_handling,
  gk_kicking,
  gk_positioning,
  gk_reflexes,
  rn AS latest_rank
FROM (
  SELECT
    pa.*, 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY player_api_id, player_fifa_api_id
      ORDER BY datetime(date) DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM Player_Attributes pa
) sub
WHERE rn = 1
accepted.description: For each player (player_api_id and player_fifa_api_id) provide the most recent Player_Attributes snapshot (by date). Useful when you need a single canonical attribute row per player for joins, cohort selection, or profiling. | Use for: Join player attributes to matches or teams without picking wrong-time snapshots; List players with their current overall_rating/potential; Aggregate top performers by overall_rating across players

accepted.description: Unpivot Match lineup columns to one row per match-player appearance, preserving home/away side and lineup position. Useful to analyze player participation, link players to matches, and join player attributes keyed by player_api_id. | Use for: Which players played in a given match or season; Join player attributes (snapshots) to appearances using match date; Compute player-level aggregates across appearances (minutes played if available, goals, cards parsed separately)

accepted.name: match_basic_summary
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  match_api_id,
  country_id,
  league_id,
  season,
  stage,
  date,
  home_team_api_id,
  away_team_api_id,
  home_team_goal,
  away_team_goal,
  -- attempt to normalize possession: remove trailing '%' and cast where possible
  CASE
    WHEN trim(possession) = '' THEN NULL
    WHEN instr(possession, '%') > 0 THEN CAST(replace(possession, '%', '') AS REAL)
    ELSE CAST(possession AS REAL)
  END AS possession,
  B365H,
  B365D,
  B365A,
  WHH,
  WHD,
  WHA
FROM Match
accepted.description: Normalized match-level projection that cleans and exposes primary identifiers, scores, possession as numeric percent (when possible), and common betting odds. Use as a clean starting point for match analytics and joins. | Use for: Modeling outcomes using odds and possession; Season-level aggregates of goals and possession; Filtering matches by league/season and joining to team/player data

accepted.name: player_age_at_match
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  mlu.id AS id,
  mlu.match_api_id AS match_api_id,
  mlu.date AS date,
  mlu.season AS season,
  mlu.league_id AS league_id,
  mlu.country_id AS country_id,
  mlu.home_team_api_id AS home_team_api_id,
  mlu.away_team_api_id AS away_team_api_id,
  mlu.side AS side,
  mlu.lineup_position AS lineup_position,
  mlu.player_api_id AS player_api_id,
  p.player_name AS player_name,
  p.birthday AS birthday,
  -- age in years (fractional) computed as difference in days / 365.25
  CASE WHEN p.birthday IS NULL OR mlu.date IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE (julianday(mlu.date) - julianday(p.birthday)) / 365.25
  END AS age_years
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM match_lineup_players_unpivot
) mlu
LEFT JOIN Player p
  ON mlu.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
accepted.description: Join Player to Match (via appearances) and compute player's age at the match date. Uses Match lineup unpivot to attach player_api_id to matches, then joins Player to compute age in years. Useful for analyses that need player age at time of appearance. | Use for: Analyze performance by player age at match time; Filter appearances by age bands (e.g., youth players); Combine age with player attributes valid at match time
